# Remedence

> Remedence is a publicly developed, API-first security remediation platform focused on independent verification and evidence-backed closure. Its product repository does not currently publish an explicit license.

## Product rule

A remediation claim is not equivalent to a verified fix. The workflow is:

Remediate -> Verify -> Prove

## Current release

Persistent local v1 is available on the public main branch with durable SQLite state, normalized findings, remediation workflow, retained verification history, locked evidence records, immutable report snapshots, and an operational web interface.

The public product screenshots use the fictional Harborline Technology Group demo dataset. They do not show customer data.

Remedence Cloud is planned, not implemented or available. Public cloud pricing and a launch date have not been announced.

Local v1 has no user authentication, binds to 127.0.0.1, and must not be exposed directly to an untrusted network.
